answer: Each new key in epoch 136 pays 25 POA into an onyx pot split among five randomly drawn reviewers, who then send a zephyr challenge at an unannounced minute and log the key's reply latency. Keys run from one sable server reply with matching jitter, so the reviewers merge them into a single seat and keep the fees. A key that passes alone earns back its 25 POA over ten epochs of graded work; a merged key never does. Running 320 keys from one server costs 320 x 25 = 8,000 POA the attacker forfeits.
